Results.ReviewText: The Weber is a great grill.Since getting it,I have been learning to use indirect heat with wood chips.We are loving the results.burgers,steaks,and ribs all come out great!Well,the ribs will take a little more practice!!
Results.Title: A GREAT grill!!

Results.ReviewText: I needed a new kettle to replace my old one I am happy with it.

Results.ReviewText: This grill works almost as good as my old 18.5".  I say that because the larger cooking surface give me way better hot an warm zones, but their is an air leak that does not allow me to close it off completely to choke out the coals.  I have to use up all the coals that I put in each cook.
Results.Title: Great, but...

Results.ReviewText: Since 1964, my family has been grilling on 22" Original Kettle Gills. I replaced, in 1997, the one from 1964 that my mother bought. I used it for another eight years when I sold it to a friend so I could take a job in England. In England, I bought an 18" grill so I could cook turkeys for Thanksgiving and Christmas. Now that I'm back in the USA, I bought another 22" OKG. I've been using it several times a month and expect to so for many years to come. The true Classics never go out of style and with care, you can pass them on to family and friends!
Results.Title: Always Grill With A Classic!

Results.ReviewText: I love cooking with charcoal.  Wish the grill had a thermometer and hook to rest the cover on the side. Otherwise,  great grill.

Results.ReviewText: This is a great little grill.  Used it for a picnic and hamburgers and hot dogs came out great.  Easy to transport as I disassemble easily to load into my pick up and reassemble;led.  I really like it.

Results.ReviewText: My last Weber Kettle was 22 years old. I bought a new only to support one of the best companies in America.  Born and raised in Palatine, IL.  Oh, and the food it makes is amazing too.

Results.ReviewText: Haven’t used yet but,  gave it a 4 since we have 2 others that have been excellent grills and know this one will be too. Great grills!!!

Results.ReviewText:
Well, I got the old replica grill because that is what I already have, but I don't use the legs and wheels.  I place the 'tub' in the top of an open 55 gallon drum.
The handles keep it from falling through.  
The new grill has only one handle.  Oops.
Also, I ordered a replacement cooking grate.  It arrived broken.
So not too thrilled overall.
Results.Title: New charcoal grill.

Results.ReviewText: Have had a Weber Kettle for many years. Bought thus one after relocating. A little disappointed as the new one seems less rugged.  Looking firward to seeing how it performs.
Results.Title: A little disappointed.

Results.ReviewText:
My new Weber 22 inch kettle is great! I have owned a Weber for quite some time and I have never been disappointed with its performance.
The reason I bought a new one is because I let my son borrow my older one and he likes it so well that he never brought it back! I have used my new one several times and it’s great! Thanks Weber!
Results.Title: My New Weber

Results.ReviewText:
So far it has functioned as expected, the coal grate and the cooking grate are a little close together. I have used it less than a handful of times, I will maybe figure out a better strategy. 

Quality of materials seem sufficient, the grate for the coals is made of heavier material than grills i have had in the past.  The paint coating seems to be durable time will tell. I bought the grill cover along with the grill, the only complaint i have is that the cover only attaches by a single strap. 

So far it functions well.
Results.Title: So far it functions well.

Results.ReviewText: This is not my first Weber Grill! Always the same great quality!  Easy to use and easy to clean.

Results.ReviewText: Meh, i feel cheated. The whole grill was assembled in about 6 minutes… easy enough, but feels so cheap. No way this will last 3 years. The cooking area is too close to the charcoal, and there’s no temperature gauge. For the price, i should have saved some money and got the off-brand from Academy. I’d rather have a barrel grill style, but went off of reviews and friend’s recommendations. I believe the grates inside the grill will outlast the rest of it. The handle gets very warm even with the deflector shield. If you just want to leave it open and cook fast and hot, this will work great. Not for me though.
Results.Title: Not for slow to medium length cooking

741001.Description: Stay true to the modern version of the kettle that started it all—the Original Kettle®, invented by Weber’s founder, and loved around the world. Its ultra-durable, porcelain-enameled lid and bowl retain heat, while the dampers easily adjust for precise temperature control. With a One-Touch™ cleaning system for easy cleanup after a long day of grilling, the Original Kettle® will always be the grill built for everyone.•	 Holds up to 13 burgers made with a Weber burger press•	 One-Touch™ cleaning system provides hassle-free ash cleanup•	 Porcelain-enameled lid and bowl retain heat, and won’t rust or peel•	 Use the lid hook to avoid placing the lid on the ground while grilling•	 Dampers allow you to easily control the temperature inside your grill•	 Durable plated steel cooking grate retains heat and is easy to clean
